name: fitted_case
title: Fitted case for a product
summary: Tray case for a real product in the catalog (a board, a power bank, a gadget), built from the maker's published sizes: a window for every port it locates, open where its ports are not located, standoffs under a board, and an optional snap or friction hold.

params.name: product
params.help: the exact product, from the catalog (stone show reads it from the request)

params.name: style
params.help: tray = open on top; sleeve = open on top and at the +y end

params.name: material
params.help: the filament; TPU makes a flexible sleeve that grips

params.name: fit
params.help: slip = 0.3 mm room per side; snug = 0.15 (TPU: 0.1 mm grip); press = a light press

params.name: retention
params.help: what holds the product in: auto = friction for a snug fit or TPU, else none; snap = two snap arms
